from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CompanySalesCash(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data point from one company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code associated with the company, if available in the report")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the data (e.g., 2025 Q1)")
    sales_cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The value of 'Cash received from selling goods' as a numeric amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount (e.g., CNY)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data from all documents."""
    company_sales_data: List[CompanySalesCash]
